name: Fingerstyle bass, smooth opto
desc: Opto 4:1, slow attack, two-stage release: fingerstyle notes even out, warm and unobtrusive

refs.why: mixer Mick Guzauski picks a slow LA-2A for smooth vocals and bass
refs.source: Universal Audio blog, 10 Questions with Mick Guzauski (undated)

notes: Opto's release lengthens after long reduction, so a held note never swells back up audibly
